jobs.prompt: Create tests/command-center-routes-flag.test.mjs, a route level test for the flag in tools/watch-server.mjs (read it, tools/command-center-flag.mjs and the existing tests/command-center-flag.test.mjs and the watch server tests such as tests/watch-server.test.mjs for the fake server pattern: createWatchServer with fake board and nav callbacks on a free port, node:test, no browser). Cases: with the flag off (option or environment unset) GET /command-center, /command-center/project/abc, /api/command-center and /api/command-center/project?id=abc all answer 404 exactly like an unknown path, and GET / still serves the classic board page unchanged; with the flag on GET /command-center with the page token answers 200 HTML that contains the script tag for command-center-boot.js, and without a token answers the same forbidden or redirect the classic page gives; /api/command-center answers 200 JSON with stats and projects built from the fake board and answers forbidden without the token; /api/command-center/project?id= with a known project answers 200 and with an unknown id answers 404; a project id containing a slash or two dots is rejected; the classic routes /, /project and /run still answer as before in both modes. Keep every existing test passing.
